en.title: Gold BJJ Foundation Gi - Pearl Weave Jiu Jitsu Gi for Men and Women - IBJJF Competition Legal BJJ Gi
bullets: The Perfect Everyday Gi: Medium weight 450gsm Pearl Weave jacket, paired with 8oz ripstop pants. We use preshrunk fabric and reinforced stitching for a gi that fits perfectly from day one.
Rash Guard Neck Liner: Keep your neck and shoulders cool and comfortable, with this gi's fully sublimated rash guard neck liner. Perfect for hot training days!
IBJJF Competition Legal: The White, Black, and Royal Blue colors of our Foundation Gi have been carefully designed to meet all tournament rules and requirements.
Sweat The Details: Lux stretchy drawstring. Inner cuff detailing. Clean branding. Looking for a women's BJJ gi? We offer female-specific cuts on a different listing (search "Women's Foundation Gi").
Designed By Athletes: Gold BJJ is owned and operated by Jiu Jitsu athletes in San Diego, CA. We train in our gear every single day, and we are committed to making the best BJJ gis on the market.
en.description: The Gold BJJ Foundation Jiu Jitsu Gi is a Pearl Weave BJJ gi designed for all around training. It is made to conform to IBJJF competition legal standards. The jacket is a 450gsm medium weight Pearl Weave, while the pants are 10oz ripstop. This BJJ uniform comes with extra nice touches like a fully sublimated rash guard liner, inner cuff detailing, and an extra stretch elastic drawstring. The Foundation is a BJJ gi for men and women, and it is also offered in female specific cuts on a separate listing (search for "Women's Foundation Gi"). Designed for and by Jiu Jitsu athletes in San Diego, CA.
